name: Can I stay in my home during a bathroom renovation?

mainEntity.name: Can I stay in my home during a bathroom renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Whether you can stay in your home during a bathroom renovation depends on the scope of work and the number of bathrooms available. For a cosmetic update on one bathroom, staying is often feasible, though expect some noise and dust. However, for a full renovation, especially if it's your only bathroom or involves extensive demolition and utility cut-offs, living elsewhere might be more comfortable and practical. We work to minimize disruption and maintain a clean worksite regardless of your decision.
acceptedAnswer.description: Staying during a bathroom renovation depends on the project scope and available bathrooms. For extensive renovations, temporary relocation might be more comfortable.
